title: .kit/settings.yml
description: The repository's choices, read by the kit and never written by it. Delivered by kit, not edited by hand; https://github.com/empowerite/kit/blob/main/docs/modules.md says what each key means. An editor validates the file against it through a modeline: # yaml-language-server: $schema=settings.schema.json

forge.description: The provider the loop's verbs use: github or gitlab. Detected from origin's host, github.com or gitlab.com, when absent; a self-hosted forge is named here.

gate.description: What kit gate runs. A justfile ci recipe, a Makefile ci target, or a package.json ci script is detected when absent.

require_signing.description: true makes kit issue refuse a desk without a signing key.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The value a module's template takes for this key, written @key@ in the template.

trackers.description: The trackers whose issues the loop takes besides the forge's own, which answers # unless a record claims it. A reference names its tracker by its prefix: #7, AB#4521.

prefix.description: What a reference to this tracker opens with, before the number: AB# for Azure DevOps work items.

provider.description: Which tracker answers: forge for the forge's own issues, ado for Azure DevOps work items.

project.description: ado: the project a new work item is created in.

type.description: ado: the type of a new work item, Task when absent.

toolchains.description: The toolchains that put the gate's tools on PATH, in order. Detected from mise.toml, Brewfile, and toolchain.Dockerfile when absent.

file.description: brew and docker: the file it reads, Brewfile or toolchain.Dockerfile by default.

image.description: docker: the built image's name, kit-toolchain by default.

policy.description: The patterns the loop's names must match, extended regular expressions in the subset RE2 shares. A subject absent takes the kit's default; an empty pattern turns that rule off.

branch.description: The branch's name. Default: ^[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$, as kit issue makes it.

commit_subject.description: Every commit's subject past the fork. Default: ^([A-Z]+)?#[0-9]+ [^ ], opening with its issue's reference.

policy_engine.description: Which engine decides: patterns, matched in bash, or opa, over the Rego under .kit/policy. opa is chosen when absent and a .rego file is there.
